claims.claim: MetricsCollector is instance-scoped on LLMRouter, not global or thread-local
claims.evidence: router.py line 50: metrics_collector field on LLMRouter dataclass. No module-level collector. No threading constructs.

claims.claim: Config loaded lazily only when --metrics flag or env var set
claims.evidence: __main__.py: metrics block guarded by `if args.metrics or os.environ.get('AGENT_METRICS_ENABLED') == 'true'`. No import at module level.

claims.claim: Website is aspose.net from config, never hardcoded in metrics source
claims.evidence: metrics.yml: website: aspose.net. payload_builder.py reads config.website. Grep for aspose.com in src/plugin_examples/metrics/ returns 0 hits. Test proves custom website propagates.

claims.claim: All 18 verdicts from gates/models.py are mapped in metrics.yml verdict_to_status
claims.evidence: gates/models.py VERDICTS frozenset has 18 entries. metrics.yml verdict_to_status has 18 entries. Sets match exactly.

claims.claim: Router _call_openai_compatible still returns str
claims.evidence: router.py line 428: return statement returns cleaned string. No LLMCallResult wrapper. Signature unchanged.

claims.claim: Token usage extracted from resp.json()['usage'] in router
claims.evidence: router.py: usage = resp_data.get('usage', {}), prompt_tokens/completion_tokens/total_tokens extracted with .get() defaults to 0.

claims.claim: No secrets in evidence files
claims.evidence: evidence.py writes only structured data. LLMCallRecord has no prompt/completion text fields. Grep for AGENT_METRICS_TOKEN, Bearer, Authorization, api_key in metrics/ source finds only env var name references.

claims.claim: Atomic JSON writes via tempfile.mkstemp + os.replace
claims.evidence: evidence.py:13-26 _atomic_json_write uses mkstemp, writes to temp, then os.replace.

claims.claim: JSONL append-only for LLM calls
claims.evidence: evidence.py:33 opens with mode 'a' for JSONL appending.

claims.claim: Persistent post ledger outside latest/ directory
claims.evidence: Ledger at workspace/verification/agent-metrics-post-ledger.jsonl (not under latest/). Config: post_ledger_path field.

claims.claim: Dry-run never sends HTTP POST
claims.evidence: poster.py: dry_run check at line 80-87 returns before any HTTP logic. Test test_dry_run_no_http asserts mock_post not called.

claims.claim: Duplicate prevention via SHA256 payload hash in ledger
claims.evidence: poster.py: payload_hash computed, checked against ledger entries. Same run_id+job_type blocks re-POST.

claims.claim: test_only_sprint=True blocks production job_types
claims.evidence: poster.py: test_only_sprint check after dry_run check blocks non-test job_types with clear error message.

claims.claim: Google Apps Script auth uses query parameter, not Bearer header
claims.evidence: poster.py: token appended as ?token=VALUE query parameter. No Authorization header set.

claims.claim: Pipeline hook called from run_pipeline() with real PipelineContext
claims.evidence: runner.py: finalize_metrics called inside run_pipeline with ctx (PipelineContext instance), not a mock wrapper.

claims.claim: CLI flags registered: --metrics, --metrics-post, --metrics-job-type, --metrics-strict, --metrics-force-repost, --metrics-config
claims.evidence: __main__.py: all 6 flags added to run subparser. test_metrics_flags_registered confirms parsing.

claims.claim: run_pipeline signature accepts all metrics parameters
claims.evidence: runner.py: metrics_collector, metrics_config, metrics_post, metrics_job_type, metrics_strict, metrics_force_repost in signature. Test test_run_pipeline_accepts_metrics_params confirms via inspect.

claims.claim: 966 tests pass in full regression
claims.evidence: pytest tests/ -v: 966 passed, 0 failed.

claims.claim: Live test POST succeeded with HTTP 200
claims.evidence: agent-metrics-test-post-result.json: http_status=200, api_response.ok=true, message='Metrics recorded'. Google Sheet row NOT independently verified (requires authenticated access).

claims.claim: Only run command has metrics wiring; other commands not yet instrumented
claims.evidence: __main__.py: metrics flags only on run subparser. Other commands (discover-lowcode, publish-pr, etc.) do not pass metrics params. This is by design — count formulas for other commands are BLOCKED_UNTIL_COUNT_SOURCE_VERIFIED per plan.

summary.notes: Claim 19 confirmed locally (HTTP 200 in evidence files and ledger) but Google Sheet row presence cannot be verified from agent. Claim 20 is a known scope limitation, not a defect.
